shellCommands.command: ls /workspace && echo "---" && cat /workspace/package.json
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NO DOCS DIR"
find app -type f | head -50 && echo "--- config ---" && cat next.config.ts
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -ril "partial.prerender\|ppr\b\|cacheComponents" --include=*.md . | head -30
cd /workspace/app && for f in layout.tsx page.tsx loading.tsx CardStats.tsx RevenueChart.tsx LatestInvoices.tsx; do echo "=============== $f"; cat -n $f; done
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app && ls 01-getting-started/ && echo "--- glossary ppr ---" && sed -n '/Partial Prerendering/,/^## /p' 04-glossary.md | head -60
ls -R /workspace/__agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null | head -30
sed -n '/Reusing data with/,/^## /p' 01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md
ls 02-guides/ | head -40 && echo "=== loading doc ===" && sed -n '1,120p' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md 2>/dev/null
grep -n "loading.js\|loading.tsx" 02-guides/instant-navigation.md 02-guides/streaming.md 02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md 2>/dev/null | head -40
sed -n '/## Streaming with/,$p' 02-guides/streaming.md | head -120
cd /workspace && wc -l __agent_eval__/run.mjs && head -40 __agent_eval__/run.mjs && echo "... " && grep -n "CardStats\|RevenueChart\|LatestInvoices\|Suspense" __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head
git rm -q app/loading.tsx && git status --short app
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20
timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40
find .next -name "index.html" -path "*server*" 2>/dev/null | head; ls .next/server/app/ 2>/dev/null | head

python3 -c " import re h=open('.next/server/app/index.html').read() print('bytes:', len(h)) t=re.sub(r'','',h,flags=re.S) t=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t) print('TEXT:', ' '.join(t.split())) print('---has main:', '
' in h, '| Dashboard h1:', 'Dashboard' in h) "
git worktree add -q /tmp/base HEAD 2>&1 | tail -2; ln -s /workspace/node_modules /tmp/base/node_modules; cd /tmp/base && timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -12
rm -f /tmp/base/node_modules && git worktree remove --force /tmp/base && git worktree list
git stash push -q -u -- app && git status --short app && timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -8

python3 -c " import re h=open('.next/server/app/index.html').read() print('BASELINE bytes:', len(h)) t=re.sub(r'','',h,flags=re.S); t=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t) print('BASELINE TEXT:', ' '.join(t.split())) print('has
:', '
' in h, '| h1 Dashboard:', 'Dashboard' in h) "
git stash pop && git status --short app

timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -8 && python3 -c " import re h=open('.next/server/app/index.html').read() print('AFTER bytes:', len(h)) t=re.sub(r'','',h,flags=re.S); t=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t) print('AFTER TEXT:', ' '.join(t.split())) print('has
:', '
' in h, '| h1 Dashboard:', 'Dashboard' in h, '| skeletons:', h.count('skeleton-text')) "
